scope: Existing compact JSON only; no NPZ reads, policy forward, simulation, training, or tests.

definitions.frame: Zero-based pre-action record index; frame n is at n/20 seconds before action n.
definitions.steps: Terminal steps=420 is a count of executed actions, not the final pre-action index (419).
definitions.grasp: Start of the first 5-record interval with both normal forces >0.05 N; known retrospectively after n+4.
definitions.lift: Target z - block half-height >0.05 m; held additionally requires bilateral contact.
definitions.over_box: Target XY within box interior bounds; no height, release, or stability requirement.
definitions.remaining: 420 - first_over_box_frame; theoretical action budget, not stable-success dwell time.
definitions.success: Original post-action complete-task condition for 40 consecutive steps; unchanged.
definitions.drop: Existing diagnostic: first height < HALF+0.01 after the maximum, with prior >5cm lift and no over-box frame.
definitions.contact_loss: First loss of bilateral contact after first held frame and before first box frame; not by itself a drop.

definitions.grasp: both normal forces >0.05 N for 5 consecutive recorded frames; report interval start
definitions.prebox_open: width command >0.04 m after first bilateral lift and before first over-box frame; descriptive event, not proof of cause
definitions.contact_loss: first loss of bilateral contact in same interval, not necessarily a drop
definitions.times: recorded pre-action frame /20; normal complete-task trajectory only
